messages.text: Hi, thanks for reaching out to Halfmoon Pizza! What can I get started for you today? 🍕

Sure! One order of breadsticks (4 pieces) coming up. Anything else?

Got it. Pepperoni Pizza, large 14-inch. Want any add-ons or a crust?
add banana peppers and stuffed crust pls 🙌 that's all for now, thanks!!
Perfect, so far we have breadsticks plus a large pepperoni with banana peppers and stuffed crust. Anything else?
oh wait, actually scratch the breadsticks, just do the pepperoni pizza, a couple of extras and I'm good 😅
